```tsx
                                        unit=" %"
                                        onChange={(val) => setThighWidthRatio(val / 100)}
                                    />
                                    <SliderField
                                        label="裾幅 (スキニー 〜 ワイド)"
                                        value={Math.round(pantHemRatio * 100)}
                                        min={60}
                                        max={200}
                                        step={5}
                                        unit=" %"
                                        onChange={(val) => setPantHemRatio(val / 100)}
                                    />
                                </div>
                            )}

                            {/* --- 3. トップス・スカート専用デザイン調整 --- */}
                            {category !== "ボトムス" && (
                                <div className="space-y-4 pt-2">
                                    <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold tracking-wider text-[#e4bf70] border-b border-[#333] pb-1 block">
                                        ■ シルエット・デザイン調整
                                    </span>
                                    {category !== "スカート" && (
                                        <SliderField
                                            label="ウエストのくびれ"
                                            value={waistCurve}
                                            min={0}
                                            max={10}
                                            step={1}
                                            unit=" 段階"
                                            onChange={setWaistCurve}
                                        />
                                    )}
                                    <SliderField
                                        label="裾の広がり（フレア）"
                                        value={hemFlare}
                                        min={0}
                                        max={10}
                                        step={1}
                                        unit=" 段階"
                                        onChange={setHemFlare}
                                    />
                                    {category !== "スカート" && (
                                        <>
                                            <SliderField
                                                label="パフスリーブ（袖山の膨らみ）"
                                                value={puffVolume}
                                                min={0}
                                                max={10}
                                                step={1}
                                                unit=" 段階"
                                                onChange={setPuffVolume}
                                            />
                                            <SliderField
                                                label="袖口の広がり（ベルスリーブ）"
                                                value={Math.round(cuffWidthRatio * 100)}
                                                min={60}
                                                max={220}
                                                step={5}
                                                unit=" %"
                                                onChange={(val) => setCuffWidthRatio(val / 100)}
                                            />
                                            <SliderField
                                                label="襟ぐりの深さ"
                                                value={neckDepth}
                                                min={1}
                                                max={5}
                                                step={1}
                                                unit=" 段階"
                                                onChange={setNeckDepth}
                                            />
                                        </>
                                    )}
                                </div>
                            )}

                            <p className="text-[11px] leading-5 text-neutral-400">
                                ※ スライダーで型紙寸法の微調整を行えます。
                            </p>
                        </div>
                    )}
                </aside>
            </section>

            {/* フッターダウンロード */}
            <footer className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 pb-16 sm:px-10 flex justify-center lg:justify-start">
                <button
                    type="button"
                    className="group relative p-[1px] transition-transform active:scale-[0.98]"
                >
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#d4af37] via-[#f3e5ab] to-[#aa771c] transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100 opacity-80" />
                    <div className="relative flex h-[40px] w-[200px] items-center justify-center bg-[#000000] px-6 transition group-hover:bg-[#000000]/80">
                        <span className="text-sm font-light tracking-[0.25em] text-[#f5ebd7] group-hover:text-white">
                            ダウンロード
                        </span>
                    </div>
                </button>
            </footer>
        </main>
    );
}

```







ドール服・ぬいぐるみ服の本格的なパターンメイキングとして、**「上半身（身頃）」と「スカート部分（フレア・ギャザー）」が完全に分離した上下セパレート（切り替え）タイプのワンピース型紙**ですね！

この構造にすると、ウエスト部分にゴムを入れたり、ギャザーをたっぷり寄せたふんわり可愛いスカートをドッキングさせたりする本格的な洋裁が可能になります。

### 今回追加・刷新するポイント

1. **カテゴリまたはデザイン調整に「上下切り替え（ウエスト切り替え）」のワンピース構造を追加**
* **上半身パーツ**: 前身頃・後身頃・袖（丈がウエスト切り替え位置まででスッキリした丈になります）
* **スカートパーツ**: ウエストベルトまたはウエスト線から裾に向かってふんわり広がる「フレア/ギャザースカート専用パーツ（長方形または扇形）」を独立して展開


2. **「ふんわり度（ギャザー・フレア分量）」のスライダー連動**
* スカートの広がりをスライダーで自由に変更でき、ギャザーを寄せたときのボリューム感をそのまま平置き型紙に反映



---

### `src/app/page.tsx` （全体コード：上下切り替えワンピース対応版）

```tsx
"use client";

import Image from "next/image";
import { ChangeEvent, useEffect, useState } from "react";

type SelectFieldProps = {
    label: string;
    value: string;
    options: string[];
    disabled?: boolean;
    useAltIcon?: boolean;
    onChange: (value: string) => void;
};

function SelectField({ label, value, options, disabled, useAltIcon, onChange }: SelectFieldProps) {
    const iconSrc = useAltIcon ? "/images/ookiibara.png" : "/images/tiisaibara.png";

    return (
        <div className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-center ${disabled ? "opacity-30" : ""}`}>
            <span className="mb-2 block h-4 text-center text-xs tracking-[0.2em] text-white">
                {label}
            </span>

            <div className="relative w-full max-w-[280px] h-[40px] flex items-center justify-center">
                <div 
                    className={`absolute right-0 h-[2px] pointer-events-none z-0 ${
                        useAltIcon 
                            ? "bottom-[4px] left-[22px] bg-gradient-to-r from-[#663b19] via-[#48280f] to-transparent" 
                            : "bottom-[3px] left-[16px] bg-gradient-to-r from-[#966330] via-[#6d451e] to-transparent"
                    }`} 
                />

                <div className={`absolute left-0 z-10 pointer-events-none ${
                    useAltIcon 
                        ? "-bottom-[1px] h-[36px] w-[36px]" 
                        : "bottom-0 h-[32px] w-[32px]"
                }`}>
                    <Image
                        src={iconSrc}
                        alt=""
                        fill
                        className="object-contain"
                        priority
                    />
                </div>

                <div className="relative z-20 w-full pl-11 pr-6 pb-1 flex items-center">
                    <select
                        value={value}
                        disabled={disabled}
                        onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)}
                        className="w-full appearance-none bg-transparent text-center text-sm font-light text-white outline-none cursor-pointer disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                    >
                        {options.map((option) => (
                            <option key={option} value={option} className="bg-[#141414] text-white">
                                {option}
                            </option>
                        ))}
                    </select>

                    <span className="pointer-events-none absolute right-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pb-1 text-[9px] text-[#c59c52]">
                        ▼
                    </span>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

function SliderField({
    label,
    value,
    min,
    max,
    step = 0.5,
    unit,
    onChange,
}: {
    label: string;
    value: number;
    min: number;
    max: number;
    step?: number;
    unit: string;
    onChange: (value: number) => void;
}) {
    return (
        <label className="block">
            <span className="mb-1.5 flex items-center justify-between text-xs tracking-[0.1em] text-[#d8cfd8]">
                <span>{label}</span>
                <span className="font-serif text-[#e4bf70]">
                    {unit === " %" || unit === " 段階" || unit === "°" || unit === " px" ? value : value.toFixed(1)}
                    {unit}
                </span>
            </span>
            <input
                type="range"
                min={min}
                max={max}
                step={step}
                value={value}
                onChange={(event) => onChange(Number(event.target.value))}
                className="h-1 w-full cursor-pointer accent-[#d7ae5d]"
            />
        </label>
    );
}

// プレビュー描画コンポーネント（上下切り替えワンピース対応版）
function PatternPreviewSvg({
    length,
    width,
    sleeve,
    sleeveAngle,
    waistCurve,
    hemFlare,
    neckDepth,
    puffVolume,
    cuffWidthRatio,
    neckOffsetY,
    neckOffsetX,
    riseDepth,
    thighWidthRatio,
    pantHemRatio,
    category,
    size,
    seamAllowance,
    isOverlayMode,
}: {
    length: number;
    width: number;
    sleeve: number;
    sleeveAngle: number;
    waistCurve: number;
    hemFlare: number;
    neckDepth: number;
    puffVolume: number;
    cuffWidthRatio: number;
    neckOffsetY: number;
    neckOffsetX: number;
    riseDepth: number;
    thighWidthRatio: number;
    pantHemRatio: number;
    category: string;
    size: string;
    seamAllowance: string;
    isOverlayMode: boolean;
}) {
    const scale = size === "DD" ? 8 : size === "MDD" ? 11 : size === "20cmぬい" ? 16 : size === "15cmぬい" ? 22 : 28;

    const bodyW = width * scale;
    const bodyH = length * scale;
    const flatSleeveW = (width * 0.75) * scale;
    const flatSleeveH = sleeve * scale;
    const overlaySleeveW = (width * 0.42) * scale;
    const overlaySleeveH = sleeve * scale;
    const overlayCuffW = overlaySleeveW * Math.min(cuffWidthRatio, 1.2);

    const isTee = category === "Tシャツ";
    const isSeparatedOnePiece = category === "ワンピース(上下切替)";

    // 上半身身頃の丈（切替ワンピの場合は全体の約45%、通常ワンピは100%）
    const bodiceH = isSeparatedOnePiece ? bodyH * 0.42 : bodyH;
    const skirtPartH = isSeparatedOnePiece ? bodyH * 0.58 : bodyH;

    const waistIndent = (waistCurve * 2.2);
    const flareOffset = (hemFlare * 3.5);
    const puffHeight = (puffVolume * 3.2);
    const neckCurvature = (neckDepth * 4.5);

    const seamStrokeWidth = seamAllowance === "なし" ? 0 : seamAllowance === "10mm" ? 14 : seamAllowance === "7mm" ? 10 : 7;

    const crotchLength = (bodyH * (0.28 + riseDepth * 0.015));
    const thighW = (bodyW * 0.5) * thighWidthRatio;
    const pantHemW = (bodyW * 0.4) * pantHemRatio;

    const centerX = 250 + neckOffsetX;
    const topY = 170 + neckOffsetY;
    const shoulderOffset = bodyW / 2;

    // 平置き型紙用パラメータ
    const frontHalfW = bodyW / 2;
    const shoulderW = frontHalfW * (isTee ? 0.92 : 0.85);
    const neckW = frontHalfW * (isTee ? 0.4 : 0.45);
    const shoulderDrop = isTee ? 6 : 10;
    const armholeDepth = Math.min(bodiceH * 0.45, isTee ? 35 : 42);

    // 上半身身頃パス（切替ワンピース用は丈が短い）
    const frontBodicePath = `
        M ${-neckW} ${-(bodiceH * 0.5)}
        Q 0 ${-(bodiceH * 0.5) + neckCurvature + (isTee ? 6 : 12)} ${neckW} ${-(bodiceH * 0.5)}
        L ${shoulderW} ${-(bodiceH * 0.5) + shoulderDrop}
        Q ${shoulderW * 0.85} ${-(bodiceH * 0.5) + armholeDepth * 0.65} ${frontHalfW} ${-(bodiceH * 0.5) + armholeDepth}
        L ${frontHalfW - waistIndent * 0.5} ${(bodiceH * 0.5)}
        L ${-frontHalfW + waistIndent * 0.5} ${(bodiceH * 0.5)}
        Q ${-shoulderW * 0.85} ${-(bodiceH * 0.5) + armholeDepth * 0.65} ${-shoulderW} ${-(bodiceH * 0.5) + shoulderDrop}
        Z
    `;

    const backBodicePath = `
        M ${-neckW} ${-(bodiceH * 0.5)}
        Q 0 ${-(bodiceH * 0.5) + 4} 8 ${-(bodiceH * 0.5)}
        L 8 ${(bodiceH * 0.5)}
        L ${-frontHalfW + waistIndent * 0.5} ${(bodiceH * 0.5)}
        Q ${-shoulderW * 0.85} ${-(bodiceH * 0.5) + armholeDepth * 0.65} ${-shoulderW} ${-(bodiceH * 0.5) + shoulderDrop}
        Z
    `;

    // 切替ワンピ用のふんわりギャザースカートパーツ
    const separatedSkirtPath = `
        M ${-frontHalfW * 1.2} ${-(skirtPartH * 0.5)}
        Q 0 ${-(skirtPartH * 0.5) - 6} ${frontHalfW * 1.2} ${-(skirtPartH * 0.5)}
        L ${frontHalfW * 1.2 + flareOffset} ${(skirtPartH * 0.5)}
        Q 0 ${(skirtPartH * 0.5) + 12 + flareOffset * 0.3} ${-frontHalfW * 1.2 - flareOffset} ${(skirtPartH * 0.5)}
        Z
    `;

    const sleevePath = `
        M ${-(flatSleeveW / 2)} ${-(flatSleeveH * 0.35) + 20}
        C ${-(flatSleeveW * 0.35)} ${-(flatSleeveH * 0.35) - 4} ${-(flatSleeveW * 0.2)} ${-(flatSleeveH * 0.35) - puffHeight} 0 ${-(flatSleeveH * 0.35) - puffHeight}
        C ${(flatSleeveW * 0.2)} ${-(flatSleeveH * 0.35) - puffHeight} ${(flatSleeveW * 0.35)} ${-(flatSleeveH * 0.35) - 4} ${(flatSleeveW / 2)} ${-(flatSleeveH * 0.35) + 20}
        L ${(flatSleeveW * cuffWidthRatio / 2)} ${(flatSleeveH * 0.35)}
        L ${-(flatSleeveW * cuffWidthRatio / 2)} ${(flatSleeveH * 0.35)}
        Z
    `;

    // 通常スカート計算
    const skirtWaistR = Math.max(bodyW * 0.6, 50);
    const skirtLength = Math.max(bodyH * 0.65, 45);
    const skirtHemR = skirtWaistR + skirtLength;
    const skirtAngle = Math.min(0.35 + (hemFlare * 0.07), 1.1);

    const swX1 = -Math.sin(skirtAngle) * skirtWaistR;
    const swY1 = -(bodyH * 0.25) + (1 - Math.cos(skirtAngle)) * skirtWaistR;
    const swX2 = Math.sin(skirtAngle) * skirtWaistR;
    const swY2 = swY1;

    const shX1 = -Math.sin(skirtAngle) * skirtHemR;
    const shY1 = -(bodyH * 0.25) + skirtLength + (1 - Math.cos(skirtAngle)) * skirtHemR;
    const shX2 = Math.sin(skirtAngle) * skirtHemR;
    const shY2 = shY1;

    const skirtPath = `
        M ${swX1} ${swY1}
        A ${skirtWaistR} ${skirtWaistR} 0 0 1 ${swX2} ${swY2}
        L ${shX2} ${shY2}
        A ${skirtHemR} ${skirtHemR} 0 0 0 ${shX1} ${shY1}
        Z
    `;

    return (
        <svg viewBox="0 0 500 500" className="w-full h-full p-2 select-none">
            {!isOverlayMode && (
                <defs>
                    <pattern id="patternGrid" width="20" height="20" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
                        <path d="M 20 0 L 0 0 0 20" fill="none" stroke="#ececec" strokeWidth="0.8" />
                    </pattern>
                </defs>
            )}
            {!isOverlayMode && <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="url(#patternGrid)" />}

            {/* A. 写真オーバーレイ時 */}
            {isOverlayMode ? (
                <g id="finished-clothing-silhouette">
                    {(category === "Tシャツ" || category === "ワンピース" || category === "ワンピース(上下切替)") && (
                        <>
                            <g transform={`translate(${centerX - shoulderOffset}, ${topY}) rotate(${sleeveAngle})`}>
                                <path
                                    d={`
                                        M ${-overlaySleeveW / 2} 0
                                        Q 0 ${-puffHeight} ${overlaySleeveW / 2} 0
                                        L ${overlayCuffW / 2} ${overlaySleeveH}
                                        L ${-overlayCuffW / 2} ${overlaySleeveH}
                                        Z
                                    `}
                                    fill="rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65)"
                                    stroke="#111"
                                    strokeWidth="2"
                                />
                            </g>

                            <g transform={`translate(${centerX + shoulderOffset}, ${topY}) rotate(${-sleeveAngle})`}>
                                <path
                                    d={`
                                        M ${-overlaySleeveW / 2} 0
                                        Q 0 ${-puffHeight} ${overlaySleeveW / 2} 0
                                        L ${overlayCuffW / 2} ${overlaySleeveH}
                                        L ${-overlayCuffW / 2} ${overlaySleeveH}
                                        Z
                                    `}
                                    fill="rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65)"
                                    stroke="#111"
                                    strokeWidth="2"
                                />
                            </g>

                            <g transform={`translate(${centerX}, ${topY})`}>
                                <path
                                    d={
                                        isSeparatedOnePiece
                                            ? `
                                                M ${-(bodyW / 2)} 0
                                                Q 0 ${neckCurvature} ${(bodyW / 2)} 0
                                                L ${(bodyW / 2)} ${bodiceH}
                                                L ${-(bodyW / 2)} ${bodiceH}
                                                Z
                                                M ${-(bodyW * 0.6)} ${bodiceH}
                                                L ${(bodyW * 0.6)} ${bodiceH}
                                                L ${(bodyW * 0.6) + flareOffset} ${bodyH}
                                                L ${-(bodyW * 0.6) - flareOffset} ${bodyH}
                                                Z
                                            `
                                            : `
                                                M ${-(bodyW / 2)} 0
                                                Q 0 ${neckCurvature} ${(bodyW / 2)} 0
                                                L ${(bodyW / 2)} ${Math.min(bodyH * 0.3, 35)}
                                                Q ${(bodyW / 2) - waistIndent} ${bodyH * 0.45} ${(bodyW / 2) + flareOffset} ${bodyH}
                                                L ${-(bodyW / 2) - flareOffset} ${bodyH}
                                                Q ${-(bodyW / 2) + waistIndent} ${bodyH * 0.45} ${-(bodyW / 2)} ${Math.min(bodyH * 0.3, 35)}
                                                Z
                                            `
                                    }
                                    fill="rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75)"
                                    stroke="#111"
                                    strokeWidth="2.2"
                                />
                                <text x="0" y={Math.min(bodyH * 0.5, 60)} textAnchor="middle" fill="#222" fontSize="11" fontWeight="bold">
                                    {category}
                                </text>
                                <text x="0" y={Math.min(bodyH * 0.5 + 16, 76)} textAnchor="middle" fill="#555" fontSize="8.5">
                                    丈:{length.toFixed(1)}cm / 幅:{width.toFixed(1)}cm
                                </text>
                            </g>
                        </>
                    )}

                    {category === "スカート" && (
                        <g transform={`translate(${centerX}, ${topY + 60})`}>
                            <path
                                d={`
                                    M ${-(bodyW * 0.4)} 0
                                    Q 0 6 ${(bodyW * 0.4)} 0
                                    L ${(bodyW * 0.4) + flareOffset} ${bodyH}
                                    Q 0 ${bodyH + 12 + flareOffset * 0.2} ${-(bodyW * 0.4) - flareOffset} ${bodyH}
                                    Z
                                `}
                                fill="rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75)"
                                stroke="#111"
                                strokeWidth="2.2"
                            />
                            <text x="0" y={Math.min(bodyH * 0.5, 45)} textAnchor="middle" fill="#222" fontSize="11" fontWeight="bold">スカート</text>
                            <text x="0" y={Math.min(bodyH * 0.5 + 16, 61)} textAnchor="middle" fill="#555" fontSize="8.5">丈:{length.toFixed(1)}cm</text>
                        </g>
                    )}

                    {category === "ボトムス" && (
                        <g transform={`translate(${centerX}, ${topY + 60})`}>
                            {[-1, 1].map((dir, idx) => (
                                <path
                                    key={idx}
                                    d={`
                                        M ${dir * 3} 0
                                        L ${dir * (bodyW * 0.35)} 0
                                        L ${dir * (bodyW * 0.35 + (thighW * 0.2))} ${crotchLength}
                                        L ${dir * (pantHemW / 2 + 10)} ${bodyH}
                                        L ${dir * 4} ${bodyH}
                                        L ${dir * 4} ${crotchLength}
                                        Z
                                    `}
                                    fill="rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75)"
                                    stroke="#111"
                                    strokeWidth="2.2"
                                />
                            ))}
                            <text x="0" y={Math.min(bodyH * 0.4, 40)} textAnchor="middle" fill="#222" fontSize="11" fontWeight="bold">パンツ</text>
                        </g>
                    )}
                </g>
            ) : (
                /* B. 平置き型紙時：上下切り替え対応版 */
                <g id="flat-pattern-pieces" transform="translate(0, 0)">
                    {(category === "Tシャツ" || category === "ワンピース") && (
                        <>
                            {/* 前身頃（切替ワンピの場合は上半身身頃） */}
                            <g transform="translate(140, 140)">
                                {seamStrokeWidth > 0 && (
                                    <path
                                        d={frontBodicePath}
                                        fill="none"
                                        stroke="#c59c52"
                                        strokeWidth={seamStrokeWidth}
                                        strokeDasharray="5 3"
                                        strokeLinejoin="round"
                                        strokeLinecap="round"
                                    />
                                )}
                                <path
                                    d={frontBodicePath}
                                    fill="#faf8f5"
                                    stroke="#222"
                                    strokeWidth="1.8"
                                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                                />
                                <text x="0" y="-10" textAnchor="middle" fill="#333" fontSize="10" fontWeight="bold">
                                    {isSeparatedOnePiece ? "上半身前身頃 (わ)" : "前身頃 (わ)"}
                                </text>
                                <text x="0" y="8" textAnchor="middle" fill="#666" fontSize="7.5">1枚裁断</text>
                            </g>

                            {/* 後身頃 */}
                            <g transform="translate(360, 140)">
                                {seamStrokeWidth > 0 && (
                                    <path
                                        d={backBodicePath}
                                        fill="none"
                                        stroke="#c59c52"
                                        strokeWidth={seamStrokeWidth}
                                        strokeDasharray="5 3"
                                        strokeLinejoin="round"
                                        strokeLinecap="round"
                                    />
                                )}
                                <path
                                    d={backBodicePath}
                                    fill="#faf8f5"
                                    stroke="#222"
                                    strokeWidth="1.8"
                                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                                />
                                <text x={-frontHalfW * 0.4} y="-10" textAnchor="middle" fill="#333" fontSize="10" fontWeight="bold">
                                    {isSeparatedOnePiece ? "上半身後身頃" : "後身頃"}
                                </text>
                                <text x={-frontHalfW * 0.4} y="8" textAnchor="middle" fill="#666" fontSize="7.5">左右2枚</text>
                            </g>

                            {/* 上下切り替えワンピ専用：ふんわりギャザースカートパーツ */}
                            {isSeparatedOnePiece && (
                                <g transform="translate(250, 360)">
                                    {seamStrokeWidth > 0 && (
                                        <path
                                            d={separatedSkirtPath}
                                            fill="none"
                                            stroke="#c59c52"
                                            strokeWidth={seamStrokeWidth}
                                            strokeDasharray="5 3"
                                            strokeLinejoin="round"
                                            strokeLinecap="round"
                                        />
                                    )}
                                    <path
                                        d={separatedSkirtPath}
                                        fill="#faf8f5"
                                        stroke="#222"
                                        strokeWidth="1.8"
                                        strokeLinejoin="round"
                                    />
                                    <text x="0" y="-10" textAnchor="middle" fill="#333" fontSize="11" fontWeight="bold">
                                        ふんわりスカート (ギャザー用)
                                    </text>
                                    <text x="0" y="10" textAnchor="middle" fill="#666" fontSize="8">前後2枚裁断</text>
                                </g>
                            )}

                            {/* 袖 */}
                            <g transform={isSeparatedOnePiece ? "translate(140, 370)" : "translate(250, 365)"}>
                                {seamStrokeWidth > 0 && (
                                    <path
                                        d={sleevePath}
                                        fill="none"
                                        stroke="#c59c52"
                                        strokeWidth={seamStrokeWidth}
                                        strokeDasharray="5 3"
                                        strokeLinejoin="round"
                                        strokeLinecap="round"
                                    />
                                )}
                                <path
                                    d={sleevePath}
                                    fill="#faf8f5"
                                    stroke="#222"
                                    strokeWidth="1.8"
                                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                                />
                                <text x="0" y="-4" textAnchor="middle" fill="#333" fontSize="10" fontWeight="bold">袖</text>
                                <text x="0" y="10" textAnchor="middle" fill="#666" fontSize="7.5">左右2枚裁断</text>
                            </g>
                        </>
                    )}

                    {category === "スカート" && (
                        <g transform="translate(250, 240)">
                            {seamStrokeWidth > 0 && (
                                <path
                                    d={skirtPath}
                                    fill="none"
                                    stroke="#c59c52"
                                    strokeWidth={seamStrokeWidth}
                                    strokeDasharray="5 3"
                                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                                    strokeLinecap="round"
                                />
                            )}
                            <path
                                d={skirtPath}
                                fill="#faf8f5"
                                stroke="#222"
                                strokeWidth="1.8"
                                strokeLinejoin="round"
                            />
                            <text x="0" y="0" textAnchor="middle" fill="#333" fontSize="11" fontWeight="bold">スカートパターン</text>
                            <text x="0" y="18" textAnchor="middle" fill="#666" fontSize="8.5">前・後 2枚裁断 (わ裁ち)</text>
                        </g>
                    )}

                    {category === "ボトムス" && (
                        <g transform="translate(250, 240)">
                            {[-1, 1].map((dir, idx) => {
                                const posX = dir * (thighW / 2 + 30);
                                const pantPath = `
                                    M ${-(bodyW * 0.22)} ${-(bodyH / 2)}
                                    L ${(bodyW * 0.22)} ${-(bodyH / 2)}
                                    L ${(bodyW * 0.22)} ${-(bodyH / 2) + crotchLength}
                                    L ${(pantHemW / 2)} ${(bodyH / 2)}
                                    L ${-(pantHemW / 2)} ${(bodyH / 2)}
                                    L ${-(thighW / 2) - (dir > 0 ? 12 : 6)} ${-(bodyH / 2) + crotchLength}
                                    Q ${-(bodyW * 0.22)} ${(-(bodyH / 2) + crotchLength - (bodyH / 2)) / 2} ${-(bodyW * 0.22)} ${-(bodyH / 2)}
                                    Z
                                `;

                                return (
                                    <g key={idx} transform={`translate(${posX}, 0)`}>
                                        {seamStrokeWidth > 0 && (
                                            <path
                                                d={pantPath}
                                                fill="none"
                                                stroke="#c59c52"
                                                strokeWidth={seamStrokeWidth}
                                                strokeDasharray="5 3"
                                                strokeLinejoin="round"
                                                strokeLinecap="round"
                                            />
                                        )}
                                        <path
                                            d={pantPath}
                                            fill="#faf8f5"
                                            stroke="#222"
                                            strokeWidth="1.8"
                                            strokeLinejoin="round"
                                        />
                                        <text x="0" y="-10" textAnchor="middle" fill="#333" fontSize="10.5" fontWeight="bold">
                                            {dir < 0 ? "前パンツ" : "後パンツ"}
                                        </text>
                                        <text x="0" y="8" textAnchor="middle" fill="#666" fontSize="8">左右2枚裁断</text>
                                    </g>
                                );
                            })}
                        </g>
                    )}
                </g>
            )}
        </svg>
    );
}

export default function Page() {
    const [size, setSize] = useState("10cmぬい");
    const [bust, setBust] = useState("DD(M胸)");
    const [category, setCategory] = useState("ワンピース");
    const [seamAllowance, setSeamAllowance] = useState("5mm");
    const [fabricType, setFabricType] = useState("ニット・伸縮生地");
    const [paperOption, setPaperOption] = useState("A4等倍");
    const [fileName, setFileName] = useState("");
    const [previewImage, setPreviewImage] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [isFineTuneOpen, setIsFineTuneOpen] = useState(true);
    const [isGenerated, setIsGenerated] = useState(false);

    const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<"overlay" | "pattern">("overlay");

    // 基本寸法ステート
    const [length, setLength] = useState(6.5);
    const [width, setWidth] = useState(4.0);
    const [sleeve, setSleeve] = useState(3.0);
    const [sleeveAngle, setSleeveAngle] = useState(60);
    const [neckOffsetY, setNeckOffsetY] = useState(0);
    const [neckOffsetX, setNeckOffsetX] = useState(0);

    // デザインステート
    const [waistCurve, setWaistCurve] = useState(2);
    const [hemFlare, setHemFlare] = useState(5);
    const [neckDepth, setNeckDepth] = useState(2);
    const [puffVolume, setPuffVolume] = useState(0);
    const [cuffWidthRatio, setCuffWidthRatio] = useState(1.4);

    // ボトムス用ステート
    const [riseDepth, setRiseDepth] = useState(3);
    const [thighWidthRatio, setThighWidthRatio] = useState(1.1);
    const [pantHemRatio, setPantHemRatio] = useState(1.0);

    const [sliderLimits, setSliderLimits] = useState({
        length: { min: 2, max: 10 },
        width: { min: 2, max: 8 },
        sleeve: { min: 1, max: 6 },
    });

    const getBustOptions = () => {
        if (size === "MDD") return ["MDD(S胸)", "MDD(M胸)", "MDD(L胸)"];
        return ["DD(S胸)", "DD(M胸)", "DD(L胸)", "DDdy"];
    };

    const handleSizeChange = (newSize: string) => {
        setSize(newSize);
        if (newSize === "MDD") setBust("MDD(M胸)");
        else if (newSize === "DD") setBust("DD(M胸)");
    };

    const autoFitImageAnalysis = (imgElement: HTMLImageElement) => {
        const aspect = imgElement.naturalWidth / imgElement.naturalHeight;
        
        if (aspect > 0.9) {
            setSleeveAngle(85);
            setSleeve(4.0);
            setCuffWidthRatio(1.3);
            setNeckOffsetY(-35);
            setWidth(4.5);
        } else {
            setSleeveAngle(55);
            setSleeve(3.2);
            setCuffWidthRatio(1.6);
            setNeckOffsetY(0);
            setWidth(3.8);
        }
        setHemFlare(5);
        setWaistCurve(2);
        setIsGenerated(true);
    };

    useEffect(() => {
        if (size === "10cmぬい") {
            setSliderLimits({ length: { min: 2, max: 10 }, width: { min: 2, max: 8 }, sleeve: { min: 1, max: 6 } });
            setLength(category.includes("ワンピース") ? 6.5 : category === "スカート" ? 3.5 : category === "ボトムス" ? 4.0 : 4.5);
            setWidth(4.0);
            setSleeve(3.0);
        } else if (size === "15cmぬい") {
            setSliderLimits({ length: { min: 4, max: 15 }, width: { min: 3, max: 12 }, sleeve: { min: 2, max: 10 } });
            setLength(category.includes("ワンピース") ? 9.5 : category === "スカート" ? 5.0 : category === "ボトムス" ? 6.0 : 7.0);
            setWidth(6.0);
            setSleeve(4.5);
        } else if (size === "20cmぬい") {
            setSliderLimits({ length: { min: 5, max: 20 }, width: { min: 4, max: 16 }, sleeve: { min: 3, max: 12 } });
            setLength(category.includes("ワンピース") ? 13.0 : category === "スカート" ? 7.0 : category === "ボトムス" ? 8.5 : 9.0);
            setWidth(8.0);
            setSleeve(6.0);
        } else if (size === "ねんどろいどどーる") {
            setSliderLimits({ length: { min: 1.5, max: 8 }, width: { min: 1.5, max: 6 }, sleeve: { min: 1, max: 5 } });
            setLength(category.includes("ワンピース") ? 5.5 : category === "スカート" ? 2.5 : category === "ボトムス" ? 3.5 : 4.0);
            setWidth(3.5);
            setSleeve(3.5);
        } else if (size === "MDD") {
            setSliderLimits({ length: { min: 6, max: 30 }, width: { min: 4, max: 18 }, sleeve: { min: 4, max: 20 } });
            const mddBustWidth = bust === "MDD(L胸)" ? 9.5 : bust === "MDD(M胸)" ? 8.5 : 8.0;
            setLength(category.includes("ワンピース") ? 19.0 : category === "スカート" ? 10.0 : category === "ボトムス" ? 16.0 : 12.0);
            setWidth(mddBustWidth);
            setSleeve(12.0);
        } else if (size === "DD") {
            setSliderLimits({ length: { min: 10, max: 40 }, width: { min: 6, max: 24 }, sleeve: { min: 6, max: 26 } });
            const ddBustWidth = bust === "DDdy" ? 13.0 : bust === "DD(L胸)" ? 12.0 : bust === "DD(S胸)" ? 10.0 : 11.0;
            setLength(category.includes("ワンピース") ? 28.0 : category === "スカート" ? 14.0 : category === "ボトムス" ? 24.0 : 18.0);
            setWidth(ddBustWidth);
            setSleeve(17.0);
        }

        if (category.includes("ワンピース") || category === "スカート") {
            setWaistCurve(2);
            setHemFlare(5);
        } else {
            setWaistCurve(0);
            setHemFlare(0);
        }
    }, [size, bust, category]);

    const handleFileChange = (event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
        const file = event.target.files?.[0];
        if (file) {
            setFileName(file.name);
            const imageUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);
            setPreviewImage(imageUrl);
            setViewMode("overlay");

            const img = new window.Image();
            img.src = imageUrl;
            img.onload = () => {
                autoFitImageAnalysis(img);
            };
        }
    };

    return (
        <main className="min-h-screen bg-[#000000] text-white selection:bg-[#9a759c] selection:text-white">
            {/* ヘッダーエリア */}
            <header className="relative isolate min-h-[360px] sm:min-h-[450px] overflow-hidden bg-[#7B83A2]">
                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-b from-transparent via-transparent to-black/30" />
                <div className="relative mx-auto flex min-h-[360px] sm:min-h-[450px] max-w-7xl items-end px-6 pt-10 sm:px-10 lg:px-16">
                    <Image
                        src="/images/header-doll.gif"
                        alt="ドールのイラスト"
                        width={580}
                        height={540}
                        unoptimized
                        priority
                        className="absolute -bottom-4 left-0 z-10 h-[380px] w-auto object-contain object-bottom sm:-bottom-8 sm:left-6 sm:h-[500px]"
                    />

                    <div className="relative z-20 ml-auto flex max-w-[850px] flex-col items-end pb-20 text-right sm:pb-28">
                        <p className="mb-3 text-xs tracking-[0.28em] text-[#f0edf5] sm:text-base">
                            イラストや写真から型紙を作る
                        </p>
                        <div className="relative -mr-2 -ml-16 h-28 w-[320px] sm:-ml-28 sm:h-44 sm:w-[580px] lg:-ml-40 lg:w-[700px]">
                            <Image
                                src="/images/logo-text.png"
                                alt="Pattern Studio"
                                fill
                                priority
                                className="object-contain object-right"
                            />
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </header>

            {/* 入力フォームエリア */}
            <section className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 py-12 sm:px-10">
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-8 gap-y-10 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 justify-items-center">
                    {/* 1. カテゴリ（上下切替ワンピース追加） */}
                    <div className="w-full flex justify-center">
                        <SelectField
                            label="カテゴリ"
                            value={category}
                            options={["Tシャツ", "ワンピース", "ワンピース(上下切替)", "スカート", "ボトムス"]}
                            onChange={setCategory}
                        />
                    </div>

                    {/* 2. 写真アップロード */}
                    <div className="w-full flex justify-center">
                        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
                            <span className="mb-2 block h-4 text-center text-xs tracking-[0.2em] text-white">
                                写真
                            </span>
                            <div className="relative w-full max-w-[280px] h-[40px] flex items-center justify-center">
                                <div className="absolute bottom-[4px] left-[22px] right-0 h-[2px] bg-gradient-to-r from-[#663b19] via-[#48280f] to-transparent pointer-events-none z-0" />
                                <div className="absolute left-0 -bottom-[1px] z-10 h-[36px] w-[36px] pointer-events-none">
                                    <Image
                                        src="/images/ookiibara.png"
                                        alt=""
                                        fill
                                        className="object-contain"
                                        priority
                                    />
                                </div>

                                <label className="relative z-20 w-full pl-11 pr-6 pb-1 flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer">
                                    <span className="truncate text-sm font-light text-white">
                                        {fileName || "アップロード"}
                                    </span>
                                    <span className="pointer-events-none absolute right-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pb-1 text-[9px] text-[#c59c52]">
                                        ▼
                                    </span>
                                    <input
                                        type="file"
                                        accept="image/*"
                                        onChange={handleFileChange}
                                        className="hidden"
                                    />
                                </label>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* 3. 大きさ */}
                    <div className="w-full flex justify-center">
                        <SelectField
                            label="大きさ"
                            value={size}
                            options={["10cmぬい", "15cmぬい", "20cmぬい", "ねんどろいどどーる", "MDD", "DD"]}
                            onChange={handleSizeChange}
                        />
                    </div>

                    {/* 4. バスト */}
                    <div className="w-full flex justify-center">
                        <SelectField
                            label="バスト"
                            value={bust}
                            options={getBustOptions()}
                            disabled={size !== "DD" && size !== "MDD"}
                            useAltIcon
                            onChange={setBust}
                        />
                    </div>

                    {/* 5. 縫い代 */}
                    <div className="w-full flex justify-center">
                        <SelectField
                            label="縫い代"
                            value={seamAllowance}
                            options={["5mm", "7mm", "10mm", "なし"]}
                            onChange={setSeamAllowance}
                        />
                    </div>

                    {/* 6. 生地のタイプ */}
                    <div className="w-full flex justify-center">
                        <SelectField
                            label="生地のタイプ"
                            value={fabricType}
                            options={["ニット・伸縮生地", "布帛・非伸縮"]}
                            useAltIcon
                            onChange={setFabricType}
                        />
                    </div>

                    {/* 7. 用紙サイズ / 出力オプション */}
                    <div className="w-full flex justify-center sm:col-span-2 lg:col-span-1">
                        <SelectField
                            label="用紙サイズ / 出力オプション"
                            value={paperOption}
                            options={["A4等倍", "A4分割印刷"]}
                            onChange={setPaperOption}
                        />
                    </div>
                </div>

                {/* 生成ボタン */}
                <div className="mt-8 flex justify-start">
                    <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setIsGenerated(true)}
                        className="group relative p-[1px] transition-transform active:scale-[0.98]"
                    >
                        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#d4af37] via-[#f3e5ab] to-[#aa771c] transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100 opacity-80" />
                        <div className="relative flex h-[40px] w-[180px] items-center justify-center bg-[#000000] px-6 transition group-hover:bg-[#000000]/80">
                            <span className="text-sm font-light tracking-[0.25em] text-[#f5ebd7] group-hover:text-white">
                                {isGenerated ? "再生成" : "生成"}
                            </span>
                        </div>
                    </button>
                </div>
            </section>

            {/* プレビュー ＆ 微調整エリア */}
            <section className="mx-auto grid max-w-6xl grid-cols-1 gap-12 px-6 pb-16 sm:px-10 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_320px]">
                {/* プレビュー枠 */}
                <div className="flex flex-col space-y-3">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs">
                        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                            <span className="text-neutral-400">表示モード:</span>
                            <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => setViewMode("overlay")}
                                className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded border transition ${
                                    viewMode === "overlay" ? "border-[#d7ae5d] text-[#e4bf70] bg-[#1a1714]" : "border-neutral-700 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white"
                                }`}
                            >
                                完成シルエット（写真に重ねる）
                            </button>
                            <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => setViewMode("pattern")}
                                className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded border transition ${
                                    viewMode === "pattern" ? "border-[#d7ae5d] text-[#e4bf70] bg-[#1a1714]" : "border-neutral-700 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white"
                                }`}
                            >
                                平置き型紙（パーツ展開）
                            </button>
                        </div>

                        {previewImage && (
                            <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => {
                                    const img = new window.Image();
                                    img.src = previewImage;
                                    img.onload = () => autoFitImageAnalysis(img);
                                }}
                                className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-[#d7ae5d]/70 text-[#f5ebd7] bg-[#1f1b14] hover:bg-[#2a241b] transition active:scale-95"
                            >
                                🪄 写真に合わせて自動位置調整
                            </button>
                        )}
                    </div>

                    <div className="relative aspect-square max-h-[580px] min-h-[360px] overflow-hidden border border-[#333333] bg-white shadow-2xl flex items-center justify-center">
                        {isGenerated ? (
                            <div className="relative w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center">
                                {viewMode === "overlay" && previewImage && (
                                    <div className="absolute inset-0 z-0 p-4 flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-none">
                                        <div className="relative w-full h-full">
                                            <Image
                                                src={previewImage}
                                                alt="服のイラスト・写真"
                                                fill
                                                className="object-contain"
                                            />
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                )}

                                <div className="relative z-10 w-full h-full">
                                    <PatternPreviewSvg
                                        length={length}
                                        width={width}
                                        sleeve={sleeve}
                                        sleeveAngle={sleeveAngle}
                                        waistCurve={waistCurve}
                                        hemFlare={hemFlare}
                                        neckDepth={neckDepth}
                                        puffVolume={puffVolume}
                                        cuffWidthRatio={cuffWidthRatio}
                                        neckOffsetY={neckOffsetY}
                                        neckOffsetX={neckOffsetX}
                                        riseDepth={riseDepth}
                                        thighWidthRatio={thighWidthRatio}
                                        pantHemRatio={pantHemRatio}
                                        category={category}
                                        size={size}
                                        seamAllowance={seamAllowance}
                                        isOverlayMode={viewMode === "overlay"}
                                    />
                                </div>

                                {viewMode === "pattern" && previewImage && (
                                    <div className="absolute bottom-4 right-4 h-24 w-24 overflow-hidden rounded border border-neutral-300 bg-white p-1 shadow-md z-20">
                                        <div className="relative h-full w-full">
                                            <Image
                                                src={previewImage}
                                                alt="元写真"
                                                fill
                                                className="object-cover"
                                            />
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                )}
                            </div>
                        ) : (
                            <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center space-y-3 text-neutral-400">
                                {previewImage ? (
                                    <div className="relative h-44 w-44 overflow-hidden rounded border border-neutral-200 shadow-sm">
                                        <Image
                                            src={previewImage}
                                            alt="アップロード画像"
                                            fill
                                            className="object-cover"
                                        />
                                    </div>
                                ) : (
                                    <div className="text-sm tracking-[0.3em] text-[#999999]">
                                        プレビュー
                                    </div>
                                )}
                                <p className="text-xs text-neutral-400">
                                    「生成」ボタンを押すと型紙が表示されます
                                </p>
                            </div>
                        )}
                    </div>
                </div>

                {/* 微調整パネル */}
                <aside className="self-start">
                    <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setIsFineTuneOpen(!isFineTuneOpen)}
                        className="relative w-full max-w-[280px] h-[40px] flex items-center text-left"
                    >
                        <div className="absolute bottom-[3px] left-[16px] right-0 h-[2px] bg-gradient-to-r from-[#966330] via-[#6d451e] to-transparent pointer-events-none z-0" />
                        <div className="absolute left-0 bottom-0 z-10 h-[32px] w-[32px] pointer-events-none">
                            <Image
                                src="/images/tiisaibara.png"
                                alt=""
                                fill
                                className="object-contain"
                            />
                        </div>
                        <div className="relative z-20 w-full pl-11 pr-6 pb-1 flex items-center justify-between">
                            <span className="text-sm font-light tracking-[0.2em] text-white">微調整</span>
                            <span className="text-[9px] text-[#c59c52]">▼</span>
                        </div>
                    </button>

                    {isFineTuneOpen && (
                        <div className="space-y-6 pt-6 pl-4">
                            {/* --- 1. 基本サイズ --- */}
                            <div className="space-y-4">
                                <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold tracking-wider text-[#e4bf70] border-b border-[#333] pb-1 block">
                                    ■ 基本サイズ
                                </span>
                                <SliderField
                                    label={category === "ボトムス" ? "総丈 (ウエスト〜裾)" : category === "スカート" ? "スカート丈" : "着丈"}
                                    value={length}
                                    min={sliderLimits.length.min}
                                    max={sliderLimits.length.max}
                                    unit=" cm"
                                    onChange={setLength}
                                />
                                <SliderField
                                    label={category === "ボトムス" || category === "スカート" ? "ウエスト幅" : "身幅"}
                                    value={width}
                                    min={sliderLimits.width.min}
                                    max={sliderLimits.width.max}
                                    unit=" cm"
                                    onChange={setWidth}
                                />
                                {(category === "Tシャツ" || category.includes("ワンピース")) && (
                                    <>
                                        <SliderField
                                            label="袖丈"
                                            value={sleeve}
                                            min={sliderLimits.sleeve.min}
                                            max={sliderLimits.sleeve.max}
                                            unit=" cm"
                                            onChange={setSleeve}
                                        />
                                        <SliderField
                                            label="腕の開き角度 (外向き)"
                                            value={sleeveAngle}
                                            min={0}
                                            max={110}
                                            step={1}
                                            unit="°"
                                            onChange={setSleeveAngle}
                                        />
                                    </>
                                )}
                                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 pt-1">
                                    <SliderField
                                        label="上下位置"
                                        value={neckOffsetY}
                                        min={-80}
                                        max={80}
                                        step={1}
                                        unit=" px"
                                        onChange={setNeckOffsetY}
                                    />
                                    <SliderField
                                        label="左右位置"
                                        value={neckOffsetX}
                                        min={-50}
                                        max={50}
                                        step={1}
                                        unit=" px"
                                        onChange={setNeckOffsetX}
                                    />
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            {/* --- 2. ボトムス専用デザイン調整 --- */}
                            {category === "ボトムス" && (
                                <div className="space-y-4 pt-2">
                                    <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold tracking-wider text-[#e4bf70] border-b border-[#333] pb-1 block">
                                        ■ パンツ・シルエット調整
                                    </span>
                                    <SliderField
                                        label="股上の深さ"
                                        value={riseDepth}
                                        min={0}
                                        max={8}
                                        step={1}
                                        unit=" 段階"
                                        onChange={setRiseDepth}
                                    />
                                    <SliderField
                                        label="太もも（渡り幅）のゆとり"
                                        value={Math.round(thighWidthRatio * 100)}
                                        min={80}
                                        max={180}
                                        step={5}
                                        unit=" %"
                                        onChange={(val) => setThighWidthRatio(val / 100)}
                                    />
                                    <SliderField
                                        label="裾幅 (スキニー 〜 ワイド)"
                                        value={Math.round(pantHemRatio * 100)}
                                        min={60}
                                        max={200}
                                        step={5}
                                        unit=" %"
                                        onChange={(val) => setPantHemRatio(val / 100)}
                                    />
                                </div>
                            )}

                            {/* --- 3. トップス・スカート専用デザイン調整 --- */}
                            {category !== "ボトムス" && (
                                <div className="space-y-4 pt-2">
                                    <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold tracking-wider text-[#e4bf70] border-b border-[#333] pb-1 block">
                                        ■ シルエット・デザイン調整
                                    </span>
                                    {category !== "スカート" && (
                                        <SliderField
                                            label="ウエストのくびれ"
                                            value={waistCurve}
                                            min={0}
                                            max={10}
                                            step={1}
                                            unit=" 段階"
                                            onChange={setWaistCurve}
                                        />
                                    )}
                                    <SliderField
                                        label="裾の広がり（フレア）"
                                        value={hemFlare}
                                        min={0}
                                        max={10}
                                        step={1}
                                        unit=" 段階"
                                        onChange={setHemFlare}
                                    />
                                    {category !== "スカート" && (
                                        <>
                                            <SliderField
                                                label="パフスリーブ（袖山の膨らみ）"
                                                value={puffVolume}
                                                min={0}
                                                max={10}
                                                step={1}
                                                unit=" 段階"
                                                onChange={setPuffVolume}
                                            />
                                            <SliderField
                                                label="袖口の広がり（ベルスリーブ）"
                                                value={Math.round(cuffWidthRatio * 100)}
                                                min={60}
                                                max={220}
                                                step={5}
                                                unit=" %"
                                                onChange={(val) => setCuffWidthRatio(val / 100)}
                                            />
                                            <SliderField
                                                label="襟ぐりの深さ"
                                                value={neckDepth}
                                                min={1}
                                                max={5}
                                                step={1}
                                                unit=" 段階"
                                                onChange={setNeckDepth}
                                            />
                                        </>
                                    )}
                                </div>
                            )}

                            <p className="text-[11px] leading-5 text-neutral-400">
                                ※ スライダーで型紙寸法の微調整を行えます。
                            </p>
                        </div>
                    )}
                </aside>
            </section>

            {/* フッターダウンロード */}
            <footer className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 pb-16 sm:px-10 flex justify-center lg:justify-start">
                <button
                    type="button"
                    className="group relative p-[1px] transition-transform active:scale-[0.98]"
                >
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#d4af37] via-[#f3e5ab] to-[#aa771c] transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100 opacity-80" />
                    <div className="relative flex h-[40px] w-[200px] items-center justify-center bg-[#000000] px-6 transition group-hover:bg-[#000000]/80">
                        <span className="text-sm font-light tracking-[0.25em] text-[#f5ebd7] group-hover:text-white">
                            ダウンロード
                        </span>
                    </div>
                </button>
            </footer>
        </main>
    );
}

```







平置き型紙で通常の「ワンピース」を選んだ際にパーツが表示されなくなっていた原因は、カテゴリの選択肢に「ワンピース(上下切替)」を追加した際、平置き型紙側の条件分岐（`category === "Tシャツ" || category === "ワンピース"`）に新しいカテゴリ名が正しく含まれていなかったためです。

また、「完成シルエット（写真に重ねる）」モードでのワンピースの形についても、上下切り替えに対応した正しい2パーツ構造（上半身＋ふんわりスカート）にブラッシュアップしました。

---

### 今回の修正内容

1. **平置き型紙の表示条件を修正**
* 「ワンピース」および「ワンピース(上下切替)」の両方で、前身頃・後身頃・袖（またはギャザースカート）のパーツが正しく描画されるように修正しました。


2. **完成シルエットの構造を修正**
* 通常のワンピースは1パーツのAライン、上下切り替えワンピースは「上半身身頃」と「ふんわり広がるスカート部分」がウエストラインで美しくドッキングした着用シルエットになるよう描写をアップデートしました。



---

### `src/app/page.tsx` （全体コード）

```tsx
"use client";

import Image from "next/image";
import { ChangeEvent, useEffect, useState } from "react";

type SelectFieldProps = {
    label: string;
    value: string;
    options: string[];
    disabled?: boolean;
    useAltIcon?: boolean;
    onChange: (value: string) => void;
};

function SelectField({ label, value, options, disabled, useAltIcon, onChange }: SelectFieldProps) {
    const iconSrc = useAltIcon ? "/images/ookiibara.png" : "/images/tiisaibara.png";

    return (
        <div className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-center ${disabled ? "opacity-30" : ""}`}>
            <span className="mb-2 block h-4 text-center text-xs tracking-[0.2em] text-white">
                {label}
            </span>

            <div className="relative w-full max-w-[280px] h-[40px] flex items-center justify-center">
                <div 
                    className={`absolute right-0 h-[2px] pointer-events-none z-0 ${
                        useAltIcon 
                            ? "bottom-[4px] left-[22px] bg-gradient-to-r from-[#663b19] via-[#48280f] to-transparent" 
                            : "bottom-[3px] left-[16px] bg-gradient-to-r from-[#966330] via-[#6d451e] to-transparent"
                    }`} 
                />

                <div className={`absolute left-0 z-10 pointer-events-none ${
                    useAltIcon 
                        ? "-bottom-[1px] h-[36px] w-[36px]" 
                        : "bottom-0 h-[32px] w-[32px]"
                }`}>
                    <Image
                        src={iconSrc}
                        alt=""
                        fill
                        className="object-contain"
                        priority
                    />
                </div>

                <div className="relative z-20 w-full pl-11 pr-6 pb-1 flex items-center">
                    <select
                        value={value}
                        disabled={disabled}
                        onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)}
                        className="w-full appearance-none bg-transparent text-center text-sm font-light text-white outline-none cursor-pointer disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                    >
                        {options.map((option) => (
                            <option key={option} value={option} className="bg-[#141414] text-white">
                                {option}
                            </option>
                        ))}
                    </select>

                    <span className="pointer-events-none absolute right-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pb-1 text-[9px] text-[#c59c52]">
                        ▼
                    </span>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

function SliderField({
    label,
    value,
    min,
    max,
    step = 0.5,
    unit,
    onChange,
}: {
    label: string;
    value: number;
    min: number;
    max: number;
    step?: number;
    unit: string;
    onChange: (value: number) => void;
}) {
    return (
        <label className="block">
            <span className="mb-1.5 flex items-center justify-between text-xs tracking-[0.1em] text-[#d8cfd8]">
                <span>{label}</span>
                <span className="font-serif text-[#e4bf70]">
                    {unit === " %" || unit === " 段階" || unit === "°" || unit === " px" ? value : value.toFixed(1)}
                    {unit}
                </span>
            </span>
            <input
                type="range"
                min={min}
                max={max}
                step={step}
                value={value}
                onChange={(event) => onChange(Number(event.target.value))}
                className="h-1 w-full cursor-pointer accent-[#d7ae5d]"
            />
        </label>
    );
}

// プレビュー描画コンポーネント（全ワンピースタイプの型紙・シルエット完全対応版）
function PatternPreviewSvg({
    length,
    width,
    sleeve,
    sleeveAngle,
    waistCurve,
    hemFlare,
    neckDepth,
    puffVolume,
    cuffWidthRatio,
    neckOffsetY,
    neckOffsetX,
    riseDepth,
    thighWidthRatio,
    pantHemRatio,
    category,
    size,
    seamAllowance,
    isOverlayMode,
}: {
    length: number;
    width: number;
    sleeve: number;
    sleeveAngle: number;
    waistCurve: number;
    hemFlare: number;
    neckDepth: number;
    puffVolume: number;
    cuffWidthRatio: number;
    neckOffsetY: number;
    neckOffsetX: number;
    riseDepth: number;
    thighWidthRatio: number;
    pantHemRatio: number;
    category: string;
    size: string;
    seamAllowance: string;
    isOverlayMode: boolean;
}) {
    const scale = size === "DD" ? 8 : size === "MDD" ? 11 : size === "20cmぬい" ? 16 : size === "15cmぬい" ? 22 : 28;

    const bodyW = width * scale;
    const bodyH = length * scale;
    const flatSleeveW = (width * 0.75) * scale;
    const flatSleeveH = sleeve * scale;
    const overlaySleeveW = (width * 0.42) * scale;
    const overlaySleeveH = sleeve * scale;
    const overlayCuffW = overlaySleeveW * Math.min(cuffWidthRatio, 1.2);

    const isTee = category === "Tシャツ";
    const isSeparatedOnePiece = category === "ワンピース(上下切替)";
    const isAnyTop = isTee || category === "ワンピース" || isSeparatedOnePiece;

    const bodiceH = isSeparatedOnePiece ? bodyH * 0.42 : bodyH;
    const skirtPartH = isSeparatedOnePiece ? bodyH * 0.58 : bodyH;

    const waistIndent = (waistCurve * 2.2);
    const flareOffset = (hemFlare * 3.5);
    const puffHeight = (puffVolume * 3.2);
    const neckCurvature = (neckDepth * 4.5);

    const seamStrokeWidth = seamAllowance === "なし" ? 0 : seamAllowance === "10mm" ? 14 : seamAllowance === "7mm" ? 10 : 7;

    const crotchLength = (bodyH * (0.28 + riseDepth * 0.015));
    const thighW = (bodyW * 0.5) * thighWidthRatio;
    const pantHemW = (bodyW * 0.4) * pantHemRatio;

    const centerX = 250 + neckOffsetX;
    const topY = 170 + neckOffsetY;
    const shoulderOffset = bodyW / 2;

    // 平置き型紙用パラメータ
    const frontHalfW = bodyW / 2;
    const shoulderW = frontHalfW * (isTee ? 0.92 : 0.85);
    const neckW = frontHalfW * (isTee ? 0.4 : 0.45);
    const shoulderDrop = isTee ? 6 : 10;
    const armholeDepth = Math.min(bodiceH * 0.45, isTee ? 35 : 42);

    const actualWaistIndent = isTee ? 0 : waistIndent;
    const actualFlareOffset = isTee ? (hemFlare * 0.4) : flareOffset;

    // パス定義
    const frontBodicePath = isSeparatedOnePiece ? `
        M ${-neckW} ${-(bodiceH * 0.5)}
        Q 0 ${-(bodiceH * 0.5) + neckCurvature + 12} ${neckW} ${-(bodiceH * 0.5)}
        L ${shoulderW} ${-(bodiceH * 0.5) + shoulderDrop}
        Q ${shoulderW * 0.85} ${-(bodiceH * 0.5) + armholeDepth * 0.65} ${frontHalfW} ${-(bodiceH * 0.5) + armholeDepth}
        L ${frontHalfW - actualWaistIndent * 0.5} ${(bodiceH * 0.5)}
        L ${-frontHalfW + actualWaistIndent * 0.5} ${(bodiceH * 0.5)}
        Q ${-shoulderW * 0.85} ${-(bodiceH * 0.5) + armholeDepth * 0.65} ${-shoulderW} ${-(bodiceH * 0.5) + shoulderDrop}
        Z
    ` : `
        M ${-neckW} ${-(bodyH * 0.35)}
        Q 0 ${-(bodyH * 0.35) + neckCurvature + (isTee ? 6 : 12)} ${neckW} ${-(bodyH * 0.35)}
        L ${shoulderW} ${-(bodyH * 0.35) + shoulderDrop}
        Q ${shoulderW * 0.85} ${-(bodyH * 0.35) + armholeDepth * 0.65} ${frontHalfW} ${-(bodyH * 0.35) + armholeDepth}
        Q ${frontHalfW - actualWaistIndent} 0 ${frontHalfW + actualFlareOffset} ${(bodyH * 0.35)}
        L ${-frontHalfW - actualFlareOffset} ${(bodyH * 0.35)}
        Q ${-frontHalfW + actualWaistIndent} 0 ${-frontHalfW} ${-(bodyH * 0.35) + armholeDepth}
        Q ${-shoulderW * 0.85} ${-(bodyH * 0.35) + armholeDepth * 0.65} ${-shoulderW} ${-(bodyH * 0.35) + shoulderDrop}
        Z
    `;

    const backBodicePath = isSeparatedOnePiece ? `
        M ${-neckW} ${-(bodiceH * 0.5)}
        Q 0 ${-(bodiceH * 0.5) + 4} 8 ${-(bodiceH * 0.5)}
        L 8 ${(bodiceH * 0.5)}
        L ${-frontHalfW + actualWaistIndent * 0.5} ${(bodiceH * 0.5)}
        Q ${-shoulderW * 0.85} ${-(bodiceH * 0.5) + armholeDepth * 0.65} ${-shoulderW} ${-(bodiceH * 0.5) + shoulderDrop}
        Z
    ` : `
        M ${-neckW} ${-(bodyH * 0.35)}
        Q 0 ${-(bodyH * 0.35) + 6} 8 ${-(bodyH * 0.35)}
        L 8 ${(bodyH * 0.35)}
        L ${-frontHalfW - actualFlareOffset} ${(bodyH * 0.35)}
        Q ${-frontHalfW + actualWaistIndent} 0 ${-frontHalfW} ${-(bodyH * 0.35) + armholeDepth}
        Q ${-shoulderW * 0.82} ${-(bodyH * 0.35) + armholeDepth * 0.65} ${-shoulderW} ${-(bodyH * 0.35) + shoulderDrop}
        Z
    `;

    const separatedSkirtPath = `
        M ${-frontHalfW * 1.2} ${-(skirtPartH * 0.5)}
        Q 0 ${-(skirtPartH * 0.5) - 6} ${frontHalfW * 1.2} ${-(skirtPartH * 0.5)}
        L ${frontHalfW * 1.2 + flareOffset} ${(skirtPartH * 0.5)}
        Q 0 ${(skirtPartH * 0.5) + 12 + flareOffset * 0.3} ${-frontHalfW * 1.2 - flareOffset} ${(skirtPartH * 0.5)}
        Z
    `;

    const sleevePath = `
        M ${-(flatSleeveW / 2)} ${-(flatSleeveH * 0.35) + 20}
        C ${-(flatSleeveW * 0.35)} ${-(flatSleeveH * 0.35) - 4} ${-(flatSleeveW * 0.2)} ${-(flatSleeveH * 0.35) - puffHeight} 0 ${-(flatSleeveH * 0.35) - puffHeight}
        C ${(flatSleeveW * 0.2)} ${-(flatSleeveH * 0.35) - puffHeight} ${(flatSleeveW * 0.35)} ${-(flatSleeveH * 0.35) - 4} ${(flatSleeveW / 2)} ${-(flatSleeveH * 0.35) + 20}
        L ${(flatSleeveW * cuffWidthRatio / 2)} ${(flatSleeveH * 0.35)}
        L ${-(flatSleeveW * cuffWidthRatio / 2)} ${(flatSleeveH * 0.35)}
        Z
    `;

    const skirtWaistR = Math.max(bodyW * 0.6, 50);
    const skirtLength = Math.max(bodyH * 0.65, 45);
    const skirtHemR = skirtWaistR + skirtLength;
    const skirtAngle = Math.min(0.35 + (hemFlare * 0.07), 1.1);

    const swX1 = -Math.sin(skirtAngle) * skirtWaistR;
    const swY1 = -(bodyH * 0.25) + (1 - Math.cos(skirtAngle)) * skirtWaistR;
    const swX2 = Math.sin(skirtAngle) * skirtWaistR;
    const swY2 = swY1;

    const shX1 = -Math.sin(skirtAngle) * skirtHemR;
    const shY1 = -(bodyH * 0.25) + skirtLength + (1 - Math.cos(skirtAngle)) * skirtHemR;
    const shX2 = Math.sin(skirtAngle) * skirtHemR;
    const shY2 = shY1;

    const skirtPath = `
        M ${swX1} ${swY1}
        A ${skirtWaistR} ${skirtWaistR} 0 0 1 ${swX2} ${swY2}
        L ${shX2} ${shY2}
        A ${skirtHemR} ${skirtHemR} 0 0 0 ${shX1} ${shY1}
        Z
    `;

    return (
        <svg viewBox="0 0 500 500" className="w-full h-full p-2 select-none">
            {!isOverlayMode && (
                <defs>
                    <pattern id="patternGrid" width="20" height="20" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
                        <path d="M 20 0 L 0 0 0 20" fill="none" stroke="#ececec" strokeWidth="0.8" />
                    </pattern>
                </defs>
            )}
            {!isOverlayMode && <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="url(#patternGrid)" />}

            {/* A. 写真オーバーレイ時 */}
            {isOverlayMode ? (
                <g id="finished-clothing-silhouette">
                    {isAnyTop && (
                        <>
                            <g transform={`translate(${centerX - shoulderOffset}, ${topY}) rotate(${sleeveAngle})`}>
                                <path
                                    d={`
                                        M ${-overlaySleeveW / 2} 0
                                        Q 0 ${-puffHeight} ${overlaySleeveW / 2} 0
                                        L ${overlayCuffW / 2} ${overlaySleeveH}
                                        L ${-overlayCuffW / 2} ${overlaySleeveH}
                                        Z
                                    `}
                                    fill="rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65)"
                                    stroke="#111"
                                    strokeWidth="2"
                                />
                            </g>

                            <g transform={`translate(${centerX + shoulderOffset}, ${topY}) rotate(${-sleeveAngle})`}>
                                <path
                                    d={`
                                        M ${-overlaySleeveW / 2} 0
                                        Q 0 ${-puffHeight} ${overlaySleeveW / 2} 0
                                        L ${overlayCuffW / 2} ${overlaySleeveH}
                                        L ${-overlayCuffW / 2} ${overlaySleeveH}
                                        Z
                                    `}
                                    fill="rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65)"
                                    stroke="#111"
                                    strokeWidth="2"
                                />
                            </g>

                            <g transform={`translate(${centerX}, ${topY})`}>
                                <path
                                    d={
                                        isSeparatedOnePiece
                                            ? `
                                                M ${-(bodyW / 2)} 0
                                                Q 0 ${neckCurvature} ${(bodyW / 2)} 0
                                                L ${(bodyW / 2)} ${bodiceH}
                                                L ${-(bodyW / 2)} ${bodiceH}
                                                Z
                                                M ${-(bodyW * 0.55)} ${bodiceH}
                                                L ${(bodyW * 0.55)} ${bodiceH}
                                                L ${(bodyW * 0.55) + flareOffset * 1.5} ${bodyH}
                                                L ${-(bodyW * 0.55) - flareOffset * 1.5} ${bodyH}
                                                Z
                                            `
                                            : `
                                                M ${-(bodyW / 2)} 0
                                                Q 0 ${neckCurvature} ${(bodyW / 2)} 0
                                                L ${(bodyW / 2)} ${Math.min(bodyH * 0.3, 35)}
                                                Q ${(bodyW / 2) - actualWaistIndent} ${bodyH * 0.45} ${(bodyW / 2) + actualFlareOffset} ${bodyH}
                                                L ${-(bodyW / 2) - actualFlareOffset} ${bodyH}
                                                Q ${-(bodyW / 2) + actualWaistIndent} ${bodyH * 0.45} ${-(bodyW / 2)} ${Math.min(bodyH * 0.3, 35)}
                                                Z
                                            `
                                    }
                                    fill="rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75)"
                                    stroke="#111"
                                    strokeWidth="2.2"
                                />
```
